claim.label: incumbent process
claim.sentence: Palletizing incumbent process Operators lifting cases off a conveyor onto a pallet by hand, or a fixed mechanical layer palletizer built for one pattern.

value.text: Operators lifting cases off a conveyor onto a pallet by hand, or a fixed mechanical layer palletizer built for one pattern.

assessment.author: editorial
assessment.rationale: Manual palletizing is among the highest injury-rate jobs in a plant, and the mechanical alternative cannot change pattern without retooling — which is why the robot displaced both.
